content.short: A community-focused server that offers discussions and insights to help guide early adopters into investing in CNFTs and Cardano native tokens.
content.description:
The Cardano Lounge started in October 2021. We are a community of Cardano enthusiasts that offer discussions and insights to help guide early adopters into investing in CNFTs and Cardano native tokens, dedicated to helping newcomers get set up, projects gain recognition, members make money, and degens stay organized. It is a place where people can speak of upcoming/existing projects and get different point of views to make decisions based off of the information.

The mint of a Lounge Ticket serves as a lifetime digital membership, unlocking holder only channels, giveaways, future airdrops, future whitelists, future project discords and future collaborations. These funds will provide the means and support to keep on building, reviewing projects, and developing other methods to help the community and holders.

With the help of our team and The Lounge Ticket holders we find, list, and rank promising projects we believe will hold short term and/or long-term value, while having fun doing it.
